highlights.description: Dolt-backed canonical store with a provider-agnostic sync engine (Aha!, ProductBoard, JPD), a per-tenant fieldmap for provider-sourced prioritization, and a hand-authored augment overlay that survives re-syncs

Full COMPASS-RICE prioritization pipeline: two-phase (LLM-judge-proposed, PM-confirmed) profile assignment with a claims-backed confidence integrity check, compile-time gating that excludes anything not yet PM-confirmed rather than falling back to a legacy score, and a PM review gate over compiled rankings

DashForge-backed analytics layer: a GuardSQL catalog/query surface over items, opportunity assessments, profile assignments, and per-profile raw evidence, plus a curated DashboardIR pack (compass-rice-all, moscow-compass-rice, compass-profile, portfolio-overview) servable or exportable to a standalone dashforge-server

Cobra CLI (library-first, thin wrappers) covering sync/db/status/augment/item/config/ui, plus the COMPASS-RICE scoring surface: assess (list/show/import/set), profile (list/propose/confirm/reject), moscow (get/set), and analytics (export-dashboards)

prism-roadmap export and rendering: canonical items convert to prism-roadmap's RoadmapItemSet, and opportunity/portfolio reports (including the COMPASS section) render to Markdown and a Marp presentation projection

added.description: Dolt-backed schema and generated Ent client for canonical items, releases, custom field defs, sync metadata, and the opportunity-assessment persistence layer (spec, assessment, portfolio dimension, evidence, rank override, report dataset)
Opportunity assessment compiler: resolves MoSCoW/RICE, runs the ranking policy, and computes portfolio dimension/capability/objective distributions
Rank materialization: executes a versioned prism-roadmap RankingPolicy and writes calculated ranks back onto assessment records
PM review gate: IR-delta edit commands (override, effort correction, reclassification, defer) with recompute, applied only against a compiled report dataset
Opportunity and portfolio report renderers: prism-roadmap report contracts to Markdown, plus a Marp presentation projection, with sensitivity-gated evidence excerpts
Augment overlay: hand-authored MoSCoW/Kano/RICE and other prioritization fields keyed by (provider, source_ref), stored apart from synced data so a re-sync never overwrites them
Fieldmap: per-tenant mapping from a provider's custom fields to canonical MoSCoW/Kano/RICE, applied during sync

Provider-agnostic sync engine: paginate any provider, run it through fieldmap enrichment, upsert into the store, record sync metadata, and commit to Dolt, with defensive pagination against infinite loops or duplicates

Dolt-backed canonical store: an Ent client over the MySQL wire protocol against a local dolt sql-server, with Dolt commits wrapping sync runs; Dolt integration tests are opt-in via OMNIROADMAP_TEST_DOLT so a plain `go test ./...` stays fast and hermetic
prism-roadmap export: converts canonical omniroadmap items into prism-roadmap's RoadmapItemSet, validated by prism-roadmap itself
omnisignalbridge: synthesizes OpportunitySpec drafts and root-cause/idea signal from omnisignal market/customer signal data, feeding the assessment pipeline
GuardSQL analytics catalog: exposes the store's standard, derived, and custom-column item metadata as a dashforge AnalyticsCatalog
GuardSQL analytics query execution: lints and evaluates a read-only query against canonical items with a dynamically built schema
Roadmap effort RICE rubric
Bundled provider registry: importing the library registers every bundled provider adapter (aha, aha-studio, productboard, jpd) so a Provider can be constructed by name
omniroadmap CLI: Cobra wiring for sync, augment, config, propose, and an embedded GuardSQL-queryable analytics UI over the store/sync/fieldmap/augment/analyticscatalog/omnisignalbridge packages

compassbridge: converts a compass-rice judge.Output into a CompassAssessment with a claims-backed confidence integrity check, and implements the two-phase (LLM-proposed, PM-confirmed) profile assignment workflow (ProposeProfile/ConfirmProfile/RejectProfile/AssignProfileDirectly)
ProfileAssignment Ent schema and an indexed compass_profile_id projection on OpportunityAssessment
ProfileAssignment store persistence (CRUD matching RankOverride's pattern); rice_score/rice_computable now derive compass-first via ResolveCompassRICE, matching ToRankInput's own precedence
review.EditProfile kind: one edit kind covering propose/confirm/reject/direct-assign for a profile assignment, persisted via the store's new SaveProfileAssignment

compile.gateRankInput: enforces the compass-first, two-phase-gated pipeline — an opportunity with no Compass assessment, or one whose profile isn't PM-confirmed, is uncomputable with an explicit reason rather than falling back to the legacy ladder RICE scale

dashforgeconnector: exposes the OmniRoadmap store as a DashForge analytics source (Catalog/Query/Close), self-registering as connector "omniroadmap"; cmd/omniroadmap-server composes DashForge's server CLI with this connector
render.renderCompass: COMPASS section in the opportunity report showing computability/human-review status and the full raw-evidence-to-band-to-score translation via compass-rice's own renderer
analyticscatalog: opportunity_assessments, profile_assignments, and per-profile (compass_<profile>) datasets, pairing normalized columns with raw evidence fields for human validation
analyticsquery: dispatches GuardSQL queries across the assessment family (opportunity_assessments, profile_assignments, compass_<profile>), joined with the latest compiled ranking

analyticsdashboards: curated DashboardIR pack (compass-rice-all, moscow-compass-rice, compass-profile, portfolio-overview), served at /api/analytics/dashboards and exportable for a standalone dashforge-server
CLI assess group (list/show/import/set) and compassbridge.IngestHumanEvidence for direct PM evidence entry, bypassing the confidence integrity check since there are no judge claims to cross-check
CLI profile group (list/propose/confirm/reject) and moscow group (get/set), writing MoSCoW ladder answers as a new assessment cycle through review.Apply
mih-reclassify CLI command: one-time, LLM-assisted migration of legacy combined "sam_som" Market Investment Horizon assessments onto the new SOM/SAM rungs, idempotent and dry-run by default

fixed.description: guardsql.Schema.Normalize() lowercases field names internally, so raw "evidence.<Key>" query names silently failed to match at query execution time; evidenceQueryName now mirrors the existing lowercase+non-alnum-to-underscore convention

compassbridge.NextCycleWithCompass silently dropped MoSCoW answers, dimensions, OKR contributions, and capability references on every re-score cycle, since OpportunityAssessment.NextCycle only carries Opportunity/Title/Cycle forward by design; it now explicitly re-copies those fields with independent slice copies

tests.description: dashforgeconnector's TestProviderAgainstLocalStore now skips rather than fails when the omniroadmap database isn't reachable on the conventional Dolt port, instead of only checking whether the TCP port was open

documentation.description: README, CLAUDE.md, and MkDocs site covering installation, provider setup, store/sync architecture, augment vs. fieldmap, prism-roadmap export, and effort evaluation
INIT-OMNIROADMAP-001 PRD/TRD/PLAN/ROADMAP for the COMPASS-RICE prioritization initiative

COMPASS-RICE pipeline guide and analytics docs (propose -> assess import/set -> profile confirm -> compile -> review -> materialize); README, CLAUDE.md, and CLI reference updated for the new command groups

dependencies.description: Sync go.sum for the dashforgeconnector/dashforge-server transitive dependency graph (huma, chi, systemforge, spicedb, aws-sdk)
Update the systemforge indirect dependency to its plexusone path, v0.10.0

Bump prism-roadmap to v0.21.0 and dashforge to v0.7.0, removing the local filesystem replace directive now that both are tagged releases; exclude github.com/KimMachineGun/automemlimit v1.0.0, which broke cobrautil/v2/cobraproclimits
